Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 4  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly compared only the years of release, leading to an erroneous conclusion that Maximum Ride came out earlier. This was a data_issue where the Planner misused the information by not considering the exact release months within the same year. This mistake was irreversible as it directly led to the wrong final result.
